processes.meter_flow_no_deal_resolution: Logistics/volume management flags meter flow with no deal or nomination and asks the deal owner to create or extend a deal or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
processes.deal_price_volume_correction: Settlements or schedulers question a Sitara deal's price or volume versus invoice or counterparty payment and ask the trader to verify and correct it.
processes.sitara_deal_ticket_request: A desk requests a new deal ticket, ticket change, or path/mapping change in Sitara or related systems and waits for the deal number back.
processes.king_ranch_monthly_election_notice: Monthly plant election notice (keep-whole, shrinkage percentage) relayed to logistics for nominations and allocations.
processes.intercompany_cleanup_tracking: Coordinators circulate and chase lists of outstanding interconnect/intercompany issues with owners and deadlines.
